title: 位置空了
prompt:
Edit the attached 16:9 live-action film frame into a later moment of the SAME room. Preserve the exact lens, camera position, crop, bed frame, stool, window, doorway, table foreground, rough wall marks, light direction, and the BOY'S exact face, hair, clothes, age, height and body proportions. Maintain its unpolished Caribbean photographed texture and natural uneven daylight.
Make only these story-state changes:
1. The adult woman is no longer present. The entire bed at the right is clearly EMPTY, with a thin cream cover lying mostly flat directly on the mattress and one ordinary flattened pillow at the far head. No human-shaped mound, no limbs, no figure or silhouette. The empty bed remains recognizably the same bed. This is an ordinary unoccupied bed, not a covered person.
2. The same brown ceramic water bowl now rests securely on the center of the EXISTING scratched stool. Do not move or duplicate the stool.
3. The boy remains STANDING on the same side of the stool, in the same back-three-quarter orientation. His posture is a little less bent. Both hands gently hold the small damp gray washing cloth ABOVE the bowl, with a visible gap; he has not yet placed the cloth on the rim. He looks at his hands, not toward the camera or theatrically into the empty space. His hands must NOT hold the bowl anymore. Keep a plausible size for the cloth; it is distinct from the bedding.
4. Remove the far background passerby visible through the doorway so the foreground boy is the only person visible; preserve the port context and foliage.
Nothing else is restaged or newly decorated. No tears, grief posing, new chair, magical disappearance effect, ghosts, blur overlays, vignette, text, readable writing, captions or watermark. This is a static first frame for a separate later shot; keep the everyday quiet and material reality.
note: 原始图片生成请求记录。视频动作以 prompts/ 中经实际首帧核对后的最终提示词为准。
